description: Source file implementing utility functions for converting between CGImage and SkBitmap, handling image data, and color conversions specific to iOS, within the skia graphics library.

methods.name: EncodesIcoImage
methods.description: Checks if NSData encodes an ICO image by comparing header magic bytes.

methods.name: CGImageToSkBitmap
methods.description: Converts a CGImageRef to a SkBitmap, allocating pixel data and drawing the image.

methods.name: SkBitmapToUIImageWithColorSpace
methods.description: Converts a SkBitmap to a UIImage with specified color space and scale.

methods.name: ImageDataToSkBitmaps
methods.description: Converts NSData image data to a vector of SkBitmaps, using maximum size.

methods.name: ImageDataToSkBitmapsWithMaxSize
methods.description: Converts NSData image data to SkBitmaps, handling ICO images and size constraints.

methods.name: UIColorFromSkColor
methods.description: Creates a UIColor from an SkColor by extracting RGBA components.
